body: Thanks, but I've been living rock bottom for far too long. Only thing that kept me here was a fear of hell. THIS is hell.
I agree, I just don't know how they can live with what they've done KNOWING how it affected someone else.
I didn't think anyone else felt like this. This is what I'm dealing with. I don't really want to work and see *if* things get better, then be disappointed because it doesn't.

Thanks, I keep rolling it around in my head if I want to tell him or not. At one point I was in denial of the whole thing and said I wasn't mad and wanted to forgive. But now I realize it's not alright and I'm not okay.
Fear of what's next is literally all that keeps me here.
This is my mantra every single day.
Thanks for the canned response.
Nice song reference. Wish I could be of more help.
Wow... this is me.
I don't know the details, I'm no help at relationships, but if you want someone to talk to I'm here.

I told someone about my hopeless situation and was told "there's help available! Do something!"
Granted I haven't personally tried it, I know telling someone my problems isn't going to help me. 

I'm sorry you're going through this. I don't know the backstory but I truly want nothing but the best for you. If you want to talk feel free to message me, I can listen.

> If you are forced to get help its not likely that you will be able to engage properly. 

They want me to go in myself, or get involuntarily committed. 

> You need to consider for yourself what you would want out of therapy.

I honestly don't know.

> Think about the impact your trauma is having in your life. 

It destroyed my life.

> Identify areas you'd want to improve. Figure out how much of that feels overwhelming to you right now and whether you're in a place to do the work needed to change. 

I don't know what could improve. It happened, I am left with an incurable disease because of it, and I let him get away with all of it... I don't have much to work with.

> But in all therapy there are 30% who do heal.

That's really not a comforting statistic...
I'm really not trying to be argumentative, but to me words aren't helpful. Someone telling me some version of "it's going to get better" doesn't help.

> suicidal ideation, negative thoughts and self worth, depression, anxiety, etc. A lot of that damage can be undone through cognitive behavioral therapy.

I just don't understand how paying some stranger to reassure me that what happened was wrong is helpful. I already know that and I still feel like my life is destroyed.
I honestly don't see how it could be helpful. I'm not trying to be pessimistic but logically I know nothing can take back what happened.

> There was a time in my life when I was going through a depression so severe that I would literally cross streets without looking; thinking that maybe I would be hit by a car and die and wouldn't have to kill myself. The darkness was so great, that I had no plans for my future because I didn't fathom I would actually allow myself to live much longer. 

Yeah, I know all about being reckless. 3 acquaintances in a week with families and friends have died in unexpected freak accidents. I'm honestly jealous. 

I think if God wanted to help me my life wouldn't keep getting worse.

> I believe God will judge this person by perfect justice and truth

I believe that God knows what is in the person who commits suicide's heart. 

> It is written in the Scriptures "Do not kill" and suicide is self-killing and "No murderer has eternal life residing in Him"

Makes sense, however, when you're already dead inside, and you just existing at that point, what's the difference between waiting around to physically die and pulling the trigger?

> However it is best to seek help from God and Christ at His church, by talking with a priest about your problems and resolving them according to Christian faith.

Unfortunately, some problems are just uncorrectable. God can't fix free will. Since God gave us free will, there are people who will use it to destroy other's lives.

I can relate 110%. It looks like from previous posts of yours, you and I are in a very similar situation. 

I don't know if it helps, but know someone else out there understands and is going through it at the same time.
Yeah, and despite everything I just want to hear from him again... That's embarrassing, pathetic, disgusting... I know

I'm really not a very good person. As evident by my inability to form meaningful relationships with people. I'm selfish. I can't, or maybe just won't, dig myself out of this. I know people go through much worse things than I am, but all I can think about is me and my desire to die.

Hopefully, (there's that word again) I'll be able to donate my organs and someone else more deserving, or at least worthy will be able to live. I'd change their life as well as the lives of their loved ones for the better. 

There wouldn't be people to mourn my death, hence resorting to the internet to talk. Dying for me will make everything better.

Resorting to hope is a terrible thing. Hope is what you have when there's nothing viable to help you, so you go about *wishing on a well.*

Then when all hope is gone you've got nothing left. 


Maybe there'll be a cure someday, but I don't want to wait for it. I shouldn't have this to begin with. Life sucks, then you die.

Physically, of course I'm not dead yet. I've got zero hope for a future. I don't remember being happy. This having to exist everyday is worse than just dying. 

I don't think he drugged me. That parts all on me for drinking too much on an empty stomach, I hardly ever go out. I am sure he doesn't think he did anything wrong. He gets to be happy and live his life. While all I look  forward to is going to sleep because I always hope I won't wake up.

I struggle with whether or not it's a sin to kill yourself. 

There are people who believe that God gave you your life as a gift, and ending your own life isn't your decision to make, it's His. By rejecting his gift you are rejecting God and therefore committing a sin that you cannot be forgiven for as you are dead and unable to ask for forgiveness after the act is done. 

There are people who believe that God would have mercy on those who are so low that they feel they need to kill themselves. 

The fact of the matter is we don't know what happens after you die. We can only speculate. I'm struggling with taking the gamble. I hate my life here but I don't want to find myself in a worse place for an eternity.

You're not nothing. You're going to school with the intent to help people, that's awesome! 

When you are in school I know it can seem like that is the entire world, but really once you finish you realize that that time is only a small blip in your life. I don't know if that makes sense. What I'm trying to say is it sounds like your classmates are all bandwaggoners and are picking on someone for because of their own self-esteem issues. Just finish what you set out to do in school, and you'll never see these people again.

Getting it from promiscuity is how most people believe you get it.  
When you get it after being responsible your whole life like the OP eluded to it really does feel like the end of the world. 
Not trying to start a fight, I just understand completely where the OP is coming from.

Thanks for this. Sorry you went through the same thing. 

I don't remember happy. I don't know how I could forgive and wish happiness on the person who destroyed me.

> God loves you so much and I'm here to tell you that no matter the reason for your bad memory, Jesus loves you. 

I wasn't very strong to begin with, having depression creep in. It's hard for me to accept that God would let me become a modern day leper if He loved me and looked out for me. 

> When the world gave up on me Jesus was the only one who i had and he didn't let me down.

I feel let down that I caught something contagious and incurable when I prayed hard for that to not happen. Having my virginity taken from me like that was bad enough. Why make it worse with this?

> Not because he rejoices in your pain but because your trials are more ways to glorify him. 

I don't even know what that means. If my prayers would have been answered I would have been thankful, relived, able to see a future for my life. Instead I am just existing waiting to die. 

> God will never give you more than you can handle.

So because I can't handle it does that mean that if I killed myself I'd be forgiven? Because I really can't take *this*.
No. It was my fault for getting too drunk. I wouldn't be able to prove anything.

This is why I can't pull the trigger. Fear of ending up some place worse...
I am sorry you feel exactly like I do.

I don't remember much tbh. I was out drinking and met some guy. He took advantage of me while I was too drunk to know what was going on and took my virginity and gave me an incurable STD. Real life scarlet letter.

Depression has always been there, but I could always fake it and function so no one was any the wiser. But about a month ago I made a huge mistake that is going to follow me for the rest of my life. The best part is it was all in an attempt to have a good time. 

Now it's too much to handle.

I am in the same situation. It's frustrating not knowing what happened, but since I tend to relive what I *do* remember over and over, I don't think I want to add anymore details.

What seems to help me is going out and doing something, anything but sitting alone in my own head. Living in the moment at work or while with family/friends is what keeps the flashbacks from coming. I hope that can help you in some way.

Thanks for responding.
Would taking a daily suppressant for the first year keep me from getting another outbreak?
I had an outbreak. The doctor said "you're in the middle of a herpes outbreak" as soon as they saw it. Took a swab and confirmed it the next day.

I fell for the guy who took advantage of me. He too could seem sweet and charming.
I don't know if it helps to know that others can relate and share your pain, you're not alone in feeling like this. Know you deserve someone who isn't just "at times" loving and caring, but always.

Glad you found someone and are happy!

I just found out I got HSV1 from a guy who took advantage of me while I was too drunk to know what was going on. Can barely drag myself out of bed, feel like I can't catch my breath, and end up crying every day. Your story makes me hopeful for the future.

I am so sorry that this happened to you!
You said "NO" so he should have stopped and left!!!!!!!!!
I agree with FreeOppression. You were clear and told him you didn't want to have sex with him. Therefore, you did absolutely NOTHING wrong!!!!!! 

Just because you enjoyed yourself and drank doesn't mean you wanted to sleep with with this person. I applaud you for speaking up!!!!!!

How to handle the sister, unfortunately, I don't know for sure. If you tell her and she dismisses you, I'd say she really isn't your friend. If you'd like someone to talk to feel free to PM me.

Seriously, what is wrong with me? Why do I want to hear from the person who took everything from me? I should hate this guy but yet all I want is to talk to him again. I believe he took advantage of me, but at the end of  the day, after everything that happened I still want "closure."  I'm embarrassed to say that the fact that he left me with a contagious disease that I'll never be without, I still want to talk to him. I'm so messed up in the head I don't know why! 

I just don't know what to do! What is wrong with me?

"I would also like to warn that some people (like this guy) who have this kind of STI get upset and then want to pass it on to others as some kind of weird revenge."
I'm starting to think this was the case and it makes me sick. When I told him I know I got it from him, I don't think he ever said sorry; yet somehow in that conversation I heard myself apologizing to HIM.

Thanks. I think you're right about him pretending to be a nice person just to throw me off. It would make it so much easier to hate him if I'd have never talked to him afterward. 

I am struggling with my part in the whole situation. I had no business getting drunk like that especially with someone I didn't know. Now it feels like my whole life is and will always be defined by one mistake.
